Diagnostic technologist with work experience in diagnostic radiology and competence in one additional modalities (CT, MRI, Angio, Cardiac Cath, Ultrasound, or Mammography), upon hire or
4-6 years Or:Diagnostic technologist with 5 years of work experience in diagnostic radiology., upon hire

Clinical Competency: Demonstrates proficiency and competence in all aspects of diagnostic radiology, fluoroscopy, surgery exams, and other applicable modality. Demonstrates competence in filming, processing, quality control. Able to teach students and new technologists. Demonstrates appropriate administering and monitoring of radiopaque material per Marian Medical Center guidelines. Identifies and initiates accurate assessment of life-threatening conditions. Assists in Imaging Services as needed, demonstrating competence in all areas or modalities assigned. Demonstrates technical knowledge of all imaging equipment in diagnostic radiology, surgery, and other assigned modalities. Places orders in HIS system, making all additions, corrections and cancellations as necessary.

Patient Care: Interviews patients for pertinent medical history and obtains consents on patients prior to performing studies as required. Transfers and positions patients. Teaches and assists students and new technologists.

Department Support: Participates in departmental meetings, in-services and committees. Responds to changes in work schedule as necessary. Performs other duties as necessary. Performs role of floor Supervisor when requested. Demonstrates ability to run work area, order supplies and assign staff duties. Performs as an instructor of technologists, students, and ancillary personnel on routine or special procedures as needed. Troubleshoots equipment and cooperates with service personnel in order to maintain minimal downtime. Responsible for initiating service on all equipment assigned to the area. Acts as a reference for other staff members.
Safety: Practices radiation safety in accordance with Marian Medical Center policies and procedures. Uses sterile technique and prevents cross-contamination.

Compliance with Policy and Procedures: Complies with safety, infection control, CHW Integrity Program, and other organizational policies. (90 day evals - department specific orientation checklists completed; annual evals - annual competency checklists completed) Complies with the organization's dress code. Arrives at work on time, as defined by the Timeliness and Attendance Policy. Attends work consistently, as defined by the Timeliness and Attendance Policy.
Other Staff Responsibilities: Actively supports the organizations mission, philosophy and strategic plan. Demonstrates good time management and priority setting.
